vb_textbox.text: The red and purple gnomes will take you to one forest, and the brown and green gnomes to another. Usually one forest will have many mushrooms at a time, however, sometimes both will have many mushrooms or neither will. Each phase lasts about 10-20 rounds usually. You can figure out which forest has an abundance of mushrooms based on the colour of the gnome you pick and sticking with that forest for a while. If the phase changes and you start earning lower amounts of mushrooms (1-4) it may be worth switching over to the other forest. Generally I found the red and purple gnomes led me to the forest with more mushrooms, but don't be afraid to go with the other gnomes if that one starts earning you less.
